T3_about.h2: What are Bio-Rad chemistry quality controls?
T3_about.text: Chemistry Quality Controls are Bio-Rad control materials for monitoring precision in clinical chemistry testing. The range includes materials for serum and urine assays in liquid and lyophilized formats. Assayed and unassayed options are available, while multiple levels support monitoring across different concentration ranges.

items.text: Liquid materials require no reconstitution, while lyophilized controls are reconstituted before use. Laboratories can choose the format that fits their workflow.
Multi-analyte materials cover a broad range of chemistry tests. For individual products, Bio-Rad provides assigned values across numerous methods and instruments.

items.q: What are Chemistry Quality Controls used for?
items.a: They are used to monitor precision in routine and specialized clinical chemistry testing. The range includes materials for serum and urine assays.

items.q: How do Liquichek and Lyphochek differ?
items.a: Liquichek controls are liquid and require no reconstitution. Lyphochek controls are lyophilized and are reconstituted before use.
Liquichek Lipids Control is listed in 6 × 3 mL and Bilevel MiniPak 2 × 3 mL; Lyphochek Assayed Chemistry Control in 12 × 5 mL and Bilevel MiniPak 2 × 5 mL.

items.q: Who supplies Bio-Rad chemistry controls in Ukraine?
